punchline: Brené Brown hands people a list of more than a hundred values and lets them keep only two; hers are faith and courage.
thirty_sec: In Dare to Lead, Brené Brown gives readers a list of over a hundred values and asks them to keep just two, because if everything is a priority, nothing is. Her own two are faith and courage. Then for each value you write three or four behaviors that show it, plus the slippery behaviors you fall into when you drift away. The value stops being a poster and becomes something you can check.
